description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Serializer, which manages serialization-based caching for HTMLPurifier definitions, including methods for adding, setting, replacing, retrieving, removing, flushing, and cleaning up cache files.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Serializer
classes.description: A class that handles serialization caching for HTMLPurifier definitions, providing methods to add, retrieve, remove, and manage cache files and directories.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a definition to the cache if it is of the correct type and the cache file does not already exist.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a definition in the cache, overwriting if it exists.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces an existing cache entry with a new definition.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached definition based on the configuration.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cache file based on the configuration.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Deletes all cache files in the cache directory.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes old cache files based on their age.

methods.name: generateFilePath
methods.description: Generates the file path for a cache file based on the configuration.

methods.name: generateDirectoryPath
methods.description: Generates the directory path containing cache files.

methods.name: generateBaseDirectoryPath
methods.description: Generates the base directory path for cache storage.

methods.name: _write
methods.description: Wrapper for file_put_contents to write data to a file.

methods.name: _prepareDir
methods.description: Prepares the cache directory, creating it if necessary and checking permissions.

methods.name: _testPermissions
methods.description: Tests and attempts to set permissions on a directory to ensure writability.
